# anthropic_service_account_workspace_member (Resource)

Add a service account to a workspace with the given `workspace_role`.

Requires an OAuth bearer. Admin API keys are not accepted.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_account_id` (String) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> ID of the service account.
- `workspace_id` (String) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> ID of the workspace.
- `workspace_role` (String) Role of the service account in the workspace. Value must be one of : `workspace_admin`, `workspace_developer`, `workspace_restricted_developer`, `workspace_user`.

### Read-Only

- `created_by_actor_id` (String) Tagged ID (`user_...`/`svac_...`) of the actor who created this membership.
- `implicit` (Boolean) True when this is the implicit default-workspace membership every service account has when no explicit membership exists. Implicit memberships have role `workspace_user` and cannot be removed.
